## TSS, Inc. Leases 380,000 Square Feet of Warehouse Space to Support Growing AI and High-Performance Computing Demand


Oct 6, 2026


GEORGETOWN, TX / ACCESS Newswire / October 6, 2026 / TSS, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSSI), a data center services company that provides integration and related services for AI and other high-performance computing infrastructure and software, today announced it has secured approximately 380,000 square feet of warehouse space developed by Fidelis at Berry Creek Business Park in Georgetown, Texas, less than one mile from the company’s state-of-the-art integration facility.
